slides.texto_narrado: The way most people check if a jar sealed — listen for the pop and call it done — is the reason half their pantry doesn't make it to spring.
I used to do the same thing. Hear the pop, stack the jar, move on.
Turns out a pop just means pressure released. It doesn't mean the seal actually held.
The real test: press the center of the lid. If it flexes *at all*, it's not sealed — no matter what you heard.
My first jar that passed that test, for real, sat on this shelf for six months. Untouched. Unspoiled.
